title: Rooms Division Suite Standard on the Breakfast Uplift for Suite Stays, Guest Folios
content:
Suite reservations carry a breakfast uplift on the Ashbury Rewards elite breakfast credit posted to Guest Folios.

**Rule.** Suite breakfast uplift: a reservation in a one-bedroom suite adds the one-bedroom suite uplift of $10.00 to each covered person's credit, a reservation in a junior suite adds the junior suite uplift of $5.00, and a reservation in any other room type adds nothing. The uplift is added to each covered person's credit before that credit is taken for the persons covered.

The room type is read from the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio: the room type booked.

## Uplift by room type

| Room type booked on the Room Reservations record | Uplift per covered person |
|---|---|
| One-bedroom suite | $10.00 |
| Junior suite | $5.00 |
| Standard king, standard two queens or deluxe king | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical credit per person and persons covered)

| Hypothetical case | Credit per covered person before the uplift | Uplift | Credit per covered person | Persons covered | Morning's figure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| One-bedroom suite | $30.00 | $10.00 | $40.00 | 2 | $80.00 |
| Junior suite | $30.00 | $5.00 | $35.00 | 2 | $70.00 |
| Deluxe king | $30.00 | None | $30.00 | 2 | $60.00 |

The uplift counts once for every person covered: in a one-bedroom suite with two persons covered it raises the morning's figure by $20.00.
